title: treg people-search: metered GTM enrichment at $0.0089 per lead
summary: Paul Mit amplifies Jason Zhou's treg people-search launch: an agent-facing catalog routing people enrichment across 60+ providers behind one token, billed per successful find at $0.0089/lead with no subscription. Open-source treg repo plus Claude plugin and MCP install.
